title: Binance Says It Has Fully Covered the $6.34 Billion Hack With Company Funds
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Binance Says It Has Fully Covered the $6.34 Billion Hack With Company Funds The exchange says users are whole after the Oct. 29 theft, paid for from SAFU, its futures insurance fund and treasury, and has published a 198-token proof-of-reserves snapshot that users cannot yet independently verify. This post Binance Says It Has Fully Covered the $6.34 Billion Hack With Company Funds first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
